Pathfinder Toolkit › Bestiary › Level 10

Behemoth Hippopotamus

Creature 10 Hugeanimal

Perception +19; low light vision, scent (imprecise) 30 feet

Skills Athletics +23, Stealth +18 (+20 in water), Survival +17

Str +7, Dex +4, Con +7, Int −4, Wis +5, Cha −2

Deep Breath The behemoth hippopotamus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

AC 29; Fort +22, Ref +17, Will +19

HP 190

Speed 35 feet, swim 35 feet

Melee ◆ jaws +23 [+18/+13] (deadly d12, reach 10 feet), Damage 2d12+10 piercing plus Grab

Melee ◆ foot +23 [+18/+13], Damage 2d8+10 bludgeoning

Aquatic Ambush ◆ 40 feet

Hiding in water, it can Swim out and Strike in one go; a foe that hadn't noticed it is off-guard.

Capsize ◆ (attack) The behemoth hippopotamus tries to capsize an adjacent aquatic vessel of its size or smaller. The behemoth hippopotamus must succeed at an Athletics check with a DC of 30 (reduced by 5 for each size smaller the vessel is than the hippo) or the pilot's Sailing Lore DC, whichever is higher.

Double Chomp ◆ The behemoth hippo makes a jaws Strike targeting two creatures adjacent to each other. Roll the attack and damage once, and apply it to each creature separately. A Double Chomp counts as two attacks for the multiple attack penalty.

Swallow Whole ◆ (attack) Medium, 2d12+10 bludgeoning damage, Rupture 26

Swallows a grabbed foe of the listed size; the foe takes damage each turn and can cut its way out by dealing the Rupture damage.

Trample ◆◆◆ Large or smaller, foot, DC 29 basic Reflex

Moves through smaller foes' spaces; each takes its Strike's damage (basic Reflex save).

Grab ◆ After a hit, it grabs the target for free (the target is grabbed until it Escapes).

Where to meet one

The Pathfinder Encounter Builder rolls the behemoth hippopotamus for fights in 🌾 grassland and 🐸 swamp.
